status: Post-first-submission adaptive experiments; original audit is now a validation window, not an untouched test.
protocol: Train features using history strictly before each cutoff. Train supervised rerankers only on completed preceding label windows. Tune on May18-Jun22 and Jun22-Jul27. Final rerankers refit on all five completed pseudo-windows. Overlapping early windows are correlated. Hidden test labels are never accessed; Kaggle aggregate feedback is used adaptively.

additional_experiments.allusers: Additional training users from supplied past logs; only those with five eligible pseudo-window targets and nonempty pre-cutoff history. Same 1260 evaluation users.
additional_experiments.long_horizon: May18-Jul27 ten-week diagnostic overlaps the existing validation periods; model labels stop at May18. Not an independent holdout. Exposure-dependent inputs rescaled to equivalent five-week units.
additional_experiments.count_targets: Training labels are full-view airing counts rather than binary Top5 membership: Poisson on raw counts and RMSE on log1p counts. Completed preceding windows only.
additional_experiments.sequence_fusion: Fixed 0.1 neural + 0.9 CatBoost reciprocal-rank blend; small positive changes on both local windows. Final sequence model refits all pre-Jul27 events.

limitations: No hidden test labels were accessed. Kaggle feedback was used adaptively; selection bias remains.
The ten-week diagnostic overlaps the five-week validation windows.
Small eSASRec adaptation, not an exhaustive neural architecture/hyperparameter search.
Most new-to-user targets still missed; previously unseen catalog items remain difficult.
not_submitted: Poisson count models: worse local MAP on both periods.
All-user horizon-normalized variants: worse ten-week local MAP than their unscaled counterparts.
Additional stored checkpoints: only a representative subset uploaded.
